CHELSEA LANE & YARMOUTH INTERSECTION
This item is being brought back for Committee consideration due to a recent collision at the intersection. Preliminary review indicates the collision was caused by failure to yield, prompting staff to re-evaluate safety measures and potential improvements. In addition, staff has collected new speed and volume data on Yarmouth Road following radar recalibration to ensure accuracy. The updated data confirms prevailing speeds remain well below the posted 25 mph limit, with an 85th percentile speed of approximately 21-23 mph and average speeds near 15 mph. These findings will be presented for Committee review along with recommendations for signage and other safety enhancements.

TRAFFIC CALMING APPLICATION - CHELSEA & CHISWICK
At the previous Traffic Safety Committee (TSC) meeting, the Committee recommended installing a "Left Turn Only" sign on Chelsea Road to prevent cut-through traffic and maintain the designated traffic pattern for school operations. The meeting minutes were presented to the City Council at its December 9 meeting. Staff is currently preparing a comprehensive map of all school-related signs to be updated, which will be submitted for Council approval at the January 14 meeting.
